svg.text: A38 · Astable clock and duty cycle
The timing capacitor repeatedly charges and discharges between the
timer thresholds. Two resistors set different charge and discharge times.
Measure period and duty cycle. Compare with T ≈ 0.693 × (RA + 2RB) ×
Use a suitable oscillator model, such as a modelled timer circuit. Vary its
timing R/C and measure period, pulse width and duty cycle. Feeding in a
predefined pulse source only supplies a clock; it does not test an astable.
A specific timer IC is not required by this syllabus.
Open the Simulation tab and press Run. Select a source or component to
see its values. Read the labelled signals, then change one quantity at a
time. Equal net labels identify connected points.
Use an equation, a truth table or a state sequence to justify your
prediction. Include units and discuss the model assumptions.
The model predicts electrical behaviour; it does not replace real practical
